description:
Delete binary code with no callers. Each item was verified by grep over src, runtime/src and lib, tests included:
- bits::bitstring_like_eq (bits.rs:650), which duplicates term.rs:488
- bitstr::decode_utf8, decode_utf16 and decode_utf32 (bitstr.rs:195, 247, 287)
- ValueKind::BINARY_REPRS (any_value.rs:136); is_binary_repr is what code uses
- SHARED_BIN_ROOM_OFFSET (bits.rs:121): only a comment in aot_main.rs uses it, and that comment hard-codes 32..40
- bitstring_like_word, an identity wrapper over is_bitstring_like().then_some
- fz_brand_bitstring_as_utf8, an identity call
- ast::BitFieldSpec::resolved_unit (ast/mod.rs:556) and default_size (:570)
- the fz_ir::default_unit_for wrapper (fz_ir/mod.rs:119)
- the unreachable BitSizeIr::ByteSizeOf construction arm (prim.rs:402); confirm it is unreachable before deleting
- the stale "thread-local BitWriter" comment (native_codegen/support.rs:98-125); it is process.bs_builder

Source: runtime.md R17, compiler.md C14.

Acceptance: deleted. The gate is green, and no pin moves upward.
title: Binary code with no callers is deleted
